decisions.evidence: Confirmed against the unchanged pre/post carrier opening Definition and all six actual dependencies: no structure map or tangent-bundle lift was specified. Schommer-Pries §1.1 p.2714 and footnotes 5–6 define the precise lifting data. The local repair supplies a defined BO(d), tautological bundle, chosen tangent classifying map and identification, fibration xi:X→BO(d) (homotopy lifting property spelled out), lift theta and compatible orientation; admissibility requires their existence and gauge arrows fix them. Updated owned manifest and all three consumer quotation mirrors. Reviewed all four direct consumers; owned claims remain sound. Outside batch-40 state-sum needs owner disposition of its assertion that the closed data instantiate the interface: explicitly supply the orientation-only lift or document its inherited choice, then synchronize contract F1/F2 quotations before closure. Its finite-spin calculation is unaffected; no outside artifact was edited.
